sources.title: SMF: Visa exemption for São Tomé and Príncipe
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Serviço de Migração e Fronteiras notice, dated 4 December 2025, sets out its current short-stay waiver categories and conditions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Cidadãos estrangeiros de quaisquer outros países podem beneficiar da isenção de 15 dias com visto Schengen ou dos Estados Unidos válido.

sources.title: Law No. 5/2008: legal regime for foreign citizens
sources.publisher: National Assembly of the Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe
sources.officialityEvidence: SMF's legal-document repository publishes the Diário da República text of Law No. 5/2008, including the visa default, exemption and issuance provisions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Com excepção dos casos de isenção ou dispensa de vistos previstos na Lei ou em acordos internacionais.

sources.title: e-VisaST entry-authorization portal
sources.officialityEvidence: The live SMF service provides the entry-authorization application flow and response process but exposes no nationality eligibility schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Terá uma resposta ao seu pedido num período de 7 dias úteis.

sources.title: SMF frequently asked questions: entry authorization
sources.officialityEvidence: SMF's live FAQ says a resident of a country without São Toméan consular representation requires individual entry authorization through eVisaST, not a routine visa on arrival.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A AE é individual e pode ser pedida ... através do eVisaST.

policies.title: Swiss ordinary passports: visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The current SMF waiver notice names Switzerland among the nationalities that may enter São Tomé and Príncipe without a visa for up to 15 days.
conditions: The live SMF notice names Swiss citizens and sets a maximum 15-day stay, a passport valid for at least three months on entry, funds, and return/onward evidence. Law No. 5/2008 supplies the ordinary-passport entry baseline; the notice does not separately describe Swiss special passports.
This is an ordinary short-visitor nationality baseline only; it does not establish work, residence, business, transit, crew, diplomatic, official or final-admission treatment.

policies.title: South African ordinary passports: visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The current SMF waiver notice states that South African ordinary-passport holders are visa-exempt for stays of up to 90 days.
conditions: The notice expressly limits this 90-day agreement entry to ordinary passports; it says separate diplomatic/service agreements were approved in November 2024.
The result is a visitor nationality baseline only and remains subject to passport validity, funds, return/onward evidence, border checks and final admission.

conflicts.explanation: The current SMF waiver notice expressly gives South African ordinary passports visa-free entry for up to 90 days.
